{"path": "todo_openrouter-deepseek-deepseek-v4.1-flash_01.html", "edit_description": "Create a complete, self-contained Todo app in a single HTML file. Requirements:
- HTML structure: a container with a header/title "Todo", an input row (text input + "Add" button) with a form so Enter also submits, a filter row with three buttons (All / Active / Completed) where the active filter is visually highlighted, a <ul> list for todos, and a footer showing the count of remaining active items plus a "Clear completed" button.
- Each todo item shows a checkbox (toggle complete), the todo text, and a delete button (×). Completed todos get a class that applies line-through text-decoration and muted color.
- JavaScript (vanilla, no external libs, in a <script> tag):
  - State: array of {id, text, completed} plus current filter ('all' | 'active' | 'completed').
  - render(): filters the list according to the current filter, builds DOM using createElement (avoid innerHTML injection of user text), attaches event listeners, updates the active filter button styling, updates remaining count, and toggles empty-state message.
  - addTodo(text): trims, ignores empty, pushes with unique id (Date.now() + random), saves, re-renders, clears input, focuses input.
  - toggleTodo(id), deleteTodo(id), clearCompleted().
  - setFilter(f), save() to localStorage under key 'todos-app-v1' (JSON.stringify), load() on init with try/catch and validation that parsed value is an array.
  - Escape user text safely (use textContent, never innerHTML for todo text).
- CSS: clean modern styling — centered card, rounded corners, subtle shadow, system font stack, responsive, hover states, styled checkboxes, accessible focus outlines. Dark-ish or light theme, tasteful.
- Accessibility: labels/aria-labels on buttons, keyboard operable.
- Everything inline in ONE file, no external resources. Output ONLY the file content."}
